record.paper_title: Invitation to H-systems in higher dimensions: known results, new facts, and related open problems
record.context_brief: Counterexamples via weak limits of perturbed solutions
record.original_question: For the p=n harmonic-map system -div(|grad u|^{n-2} grad u) = |grad u|^{n-2} A_u(grad u,grad u) and for the H-system -div(|grad u|^{n-2} grad u) = H(u) J_u, the spaces of weak solutions are closed under weak W^{1,n} convergence, even for corresponding approximate problems with a small perturbation in the dual space (W^{1,n})* added to the right-hand side. Can these weak-closure results be used to construct counterexamples to continuity by taking weak W^{1,n} limits of singular solutions to perturbed versions of those equations?

Let $n\ge 2$, let $B^n\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ be the open unit ball, and let $N\subset\mathbb{R}^d$ be a smooth compact Riemannian submanifold with second fundamental form $A$. Consider the $n$-harmonic map system for maps $u\in W^{1,n}(B^n,N)$:
$$-\operatorname{div} igl(|
abla u|^{n-2}
abla u igr)=|
abla u|^{n-2}\,A_u(
abla u,
abla u)\quad(\star)$$
and, for a bounded function $H:\mathbb{R}^{n+1}	o\mathbb{R}$, the $H$-system for maps $u\in W^{1,n}(B^n,\mathbb{R}^{n+1})$:
$$-\operatorname{div} igl(|
abla u|^{n-2}
abla u igr)=H(u)\,J_u\quad(\star\star)$$
where $J_u$ is the (vector-valued) Jacobian of $u$. Assume the following weak-closure fact: the set of weak solutions of $(\star)$, respectively $(\star\star)$, is sequentially closed under weak convergence in $W^{1,n}$; moreover, the same closure holds for approximate solutions, namely sequences $u_k\in W^{1,n}$ satisfying the corresponding equation with an additional source term $f_k$ on the right-hand side, where $f_k	o 0$ strongly in the dual space $(W^{1,n})^\ast$.

Question: Can these weak-closure properties be used to construct counterexamples to continuity (i.e., everywhere-discontinuous weak solutions of $(\star)$ or $(\star\star)$) by taking weak $W^{1,n}$ limits of sequences of singular solutions of suitably perturbed versions of $(\star)$ or $(\star\star)$?
artifact.status_search_result: No published resolution of this construction question was located. The originating discussion explicitly notes that it is not known whether the weak-closure results can be leveraged in this way, and no subsequent work appears to settle it.

status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of weak closure of solution spaces for the n-harmonic and H-system equations and related open problems concerning counterexamples to continuity.
status_evidence.claim: The question of whether weak-closure under perturbations yields counterexamples to continuity is posed as open.
